when: all five enemies are alive and no objective spawns within a minute
asks: can I split right now
is it safe to split
should I go side lane
am I good to push top alone
say: Push the side wave to the river and stop until you count enemies on the map, or go deeper only if four of them are showing.
more: A split works because someone has to leave their team to answer you. It stops working the moment you are past the river with nobody visible.
Each wave you shove buys your team a stretch where the enemy is either a player short or losing tower health.
The longer plan is their outer tower, then their jungle camps on that side, which starves their jungler before the next objective.
check: How many enemies you can see on the minimap right now, and whether the river brush behind you is warded.
breaks: If fewer than three enemies are showing, or your own team is already fighting, drop the push and walk back toward your tower or the fight.

when: one or more enemies are dead with a respawn timer running
asks: someone on their team is dead can I push
they're down one do I split
is this my window to push side
enemy just died should I take tower
say: Push hard while that death timer runs and hit the tower, or join your team if they can take an objective with the numbers.
more: A dead enemy cannot be one of the players who collapses on you, so the count you need on the map drops by one.
The timer is your exit clock. Leave the tower a few seconds before it ends, not after they show up.
If the dead player is their jungler, the objective is usually worth more than tower damage.
check: Whether an objective is up for your team, and where the other living enemies were last seen.
breaks: If the dead enemy is not the one who would answer your lane, the push is no safer than before. Stop at the river instead.
basis: pro:A dead jungler makes the objective free

when: Teleport is in your summoner spells and a dragon is the next objective
asks: which side do I split
should I be top or bot side
where do I push before dragon
what lane do I go
say: Split the lane away from the dragon and keep Teleport ready to join, or go to the dragon side early if Teleport is down.
more: Pushing the far lane makes them send someone a long walk away from the pit. Teleport then gets you to the fight faster than he can walk.
Without Teleport you are the one who arrives late, so the far lane only works if you plan to trade a tower for the dragon.
check: Whether your Teleport is actually off cooldown, and how long until the dragon spawns.
breaks: If Teleport is down and your team cannot fight four against five, walk to the dragon side before the spawn rather than splitting.
basis: pro:Teleport decides who has the extra player

when: Teleport is not in your summoner spells
asks: I don't have teleport can I still split
no tp should I side lane
I took ignite do I split or group
can I split without tp
say: Push the side next to the next objective so you can walk to the fight, or split the far side only as a straight tower trade.
more: Without Teleport, distance is the whole cost. The lane beside the pit keeps you one short walk from your team.
A far-side split with no Teleport is a trade, not pressure. Tell your team to give the objective and not fight while you hit the tower.
check: Which objective spawns next and which side lane is closer to it.
breaks: If your team will fight no matter what you say, be near them. A tower for a lost four against five is a bad trade.

asks: two of them came to me what now
they sent two to stop me
jungler and top are both on me
I'm getting collapsed on in side lane
say: Back off toward your tower and ping your team to take something now, or keep clearing waves from a safe spot if they hesitate.
more: Two players on you is the split working. Your team has an extra player somewhere else for as long as you stay alive.
Dying turns it around. They get a kill and still arrive at the next fight with full numbers.
Keep the wave pushing while you retreat, so one of them has to stay and clear it.
check: How many enemies actually came to you, and whether your team is in a position to start a tower or objective right now.
breaks: If your team is in base or dead, there is nothing to gain. Just leave and reset the wave later.
basis: pro:If you cannot contest, take something elsewhere at once

when: the enemy top is a level or a completed item ahead of you
asks: their top beats me can I still split
I lose the one v one should I split
he's stronger than me in side lane
do I split if I'm behind their top
say: Catch the wave near your own tower and then group, or split the opposite side lane from him if he stays put.
more: A split only pressures if you win or at least survive the duel. If he beats you, he pushes you in and then moves first.
Swapping sides makes him choose between following you and keeping his own pressure. Either way you get waves without the duel.
check: Which side lane their top is showing in, and whether your team can hold four against four without you nearby.
breaks: If he follows you to the other side every time, stop splitting and play as the fifth member near your team instead.

when: you are two or more levels ahead of the enemy top
asks: I'm way ahead how hard do I push
I'm fed can I just run it down top
do I keep splitting I'm two levels up
can I one v two in side
say: Shove every wave into their tower so they must send two, or walk to your team early if an objective fight is coming.
more: A lead in a side lane is worth the most when it drags a second enemy away. That is when your team should start something.
Your lead does not help if you are hitting a tower while your team loses a four against five. Time the push to end before the spawn.
check: How many enemies leave the map when you push, and how long until the next objective.
breaks: If three come for you, even a big lead will not save you. Back off before the third arrives, not when you see him.

when: game time is past 20:00 and no Baron kill event has happened recently
asks: baron's up do I split or go baron
should I push bot while baron is up
where do I go with baron alive
split or group for baron
say: Push the bottom wave past the river first, then walk up to Baron, or stay bottom with Teleport if they send someone to you.
more: A wave pushing into their bottom tower makes them choose between answering it and holding the Baron pit.
If they send one player to you, your team has the numbers at the pit. If they send none, the tower falls.
The same idea works for an elemental dragon with the lanes swapped: push the top wave, fight bottom.
check: Where all three waves are, and whether your Teleport is ready.
breaks: If your team starts Baron while you are still deep bottom with no Teleport, you made it a four against five. Leave the wave earlier.
basis: pro:Push the side waves before you posture at Baron

when: game time is past 30:00
asks: is it too late to split
can I still split late game
should I split at forty minutes
do I split or stay with team late
say: Push the side wave only to the middle of the lane and come back, or commit to a tower only when you see four enemies elsewhere.
more: Late on, one death can be the whole game because the timer is long enough to lose a Baron or the base.
A wave pushed to the middle still does work. It keeps their side lane from crashing into you during the next fight.
check: Where their strongest pick champion is, and whether your team can stall without you.
breaks: If your champion cannot escape two enemies, skip the deep push entirely and stay within one screen of your team.

when: you are a tank with no tower-taking items
asks: I'm a tank should I split
do tanks side lane
should I push side or stay with team as tank
is splitting worth it on a tank
say: Shove the side wave quickly and rejoin your team before any fight, or stay in the side lane only while nothing is spawning.
more: A tank does little to towers, so nobody has to answer you. Your value is being the front line when the fight starts.
Catching the wave still matters. It is your gold, and it stops their minions from taking your tower while the teams posture.
check: How long until the next objective, and whether your team has any other way to start a fight.
breaks: If your team has another front liner and their side laner cannot kill you, holding the side wave a little longer is fine.

when: two or more allies died in the last minute and you did not
asks: my team keeps fighting without me
they keep dying while I split
team won't wait for me what do I do
should I stop splitting they keep fighting
say: Split only on the side nearest your team so you can reach them, or stop and group if they fight again without you.
more: A split needs four people willing to back off. If they will not, your pressure is just a missing player.
Say the plan once before you leave: you push, they give ground. If the next fight still starts, adapt to them.
check: Whether your team actually backs off when you ping, and where the next objective is.
breaks: If you are the only one strong enough to win fights, grouping from the start is better than arriving after it is lost.

when: their outer tower in your side lane has fallen
asks: I took the tower do I keep pushing
outer is down do I go for inner
should I push to the second tower
tower's dead what next in side lane
say: Take their jungle camps beside that lane between waves, or hit the inner tower only when you see their jungler elsewhere.
more: Past the outer tower you are walking into the dark. Their camps pay you without standing in the lane where they expect you.
Stolen camps hurt their jungler before the next objective and make them ward their own jungle instead of the river.
check: Whether their jungle entrances are warded by your team, and where their jungler last showed.
breaks: If you have no ward and no Flash, stay on your side of the fallen tower and just hold the wave there.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I split as Fiora
what's my job mid game Fiora
do I group or split on Fiora
should Fiora side lane
say: Stay in a side lane and take the duel when one player answers, or back off and keep Riposte if a second one appears.
more: Grand Challenge shows all four Vitals on one target, and hitting Vitals heals you. That makes a single defender a losing answer for them.
Riposte blocks one burst of damage and disables. Against two players it covers only one of them, so the second arrival is your signal to leave.
check: Whether Grand Challenge and Riposte are both ready before you step up to the defender.
breaks: If the champion who answers you is far ahead on items, do not force the duel. Push the wave and move to the other side lane.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how deep can I push as Tryndamere
Tryndamere split or group
can I dive the tower on Tryndamere
what do I do mid game Trynd
say: Push deep and use Undying Rage to finish the tower or walk out, or stay shallow whenever Undying Rage is down.
more: Undying Rage means you cannot die while it lasts, so a collapse that would kill others only costs you the ultimate.
Keep Spinning Slash for leaving. Using it to go in means you walk out, and crowd control outlasts the ultimate.
check: Whether Undying Rage is ready and whether Spinning Slash is available for the exit.
breaks: If they have several stuns or roots that can hold you past the ultimate, treat yourself as a normal split pusher and count enemies first.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Yorick split or group
how do I use the maiden
do I bring maiden to fights
what's my job on Yorick mid game
say: Push a side lane with the Maiden and Mist Walkers until two enemies come, or bring her to an objective if your team needs damage.
more: The Maiden of the Mist raises Walkers from dead enemies, so the wave keeps growing while you hit the tower.
Dark Procession blocks movement. Save it for the first player who answers you, either to trap him or to cover your exit.
check: Whether the Maiden is alive and how many graves you have ready before a duel.
breaks: If the Maiden is dead, you are much weaker in the duel and on the tower. Farm safely until she is back.

when: you are level 6 and their top is a tank
asks: Trundle split or group
what do I do on Trundle after lane
should I fight their tank on Trundle
Trundle mid game plan
say: Split against their tank with Subjugate ready, or group and use Subjugate on their front line when a fight is coming.
more: Subjugate steals health, armor and magic resist, so the tank they send to stop you becomes the easiest target on their team.
Frozen Domain gives attack speed and move speed where you stand. Put it under their tower when you are taking it.
Pillar of Ice is your exit as well as your catch. Drop it behind you to block the path of the second player.
check: Whether Subjugate is ready, and whether the player answering you is a tank or a damage dealer.
breaks: If a squishy damage dealer answers instead of the tank, Subjugate gains you much less. Push and leave rather than duel.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Shen do I split or group
can I split as Shen
where should Shen be mid game
should I stay with team on Shen
say: Push a side lane and keep Stand United for your carry when the fight starts, or stay with the team while Stand United is down.
more: Stand United shields an ally and brings you to them, so you can be in a side lane one moment and at the fight the next.
That only holds while the ultimate is ready. Without it you are a tank who is a full walk away.
check: Whether Stand United is ready, and that nobody near you can stun or knock you up in the moment before you travel.
breaks: If their side laner has a stun or knock-up, push the wave and step out of his reach before you cast.

when: Teleport is in your summoner spells, before 14:00
asks: should I tp bot
do I teleport to this fight
bot's fighting do I tp
tp bot or stay top
say: Teleport if your wave is pushed and the fight is still even, or stay and take plates if the fight already looks decided.
more: Teleport pays when you are the extra body that decides it. Arriving after two allies are dead adds a third death.
The cost is top lane. With the wave on your side you lose minions and plates while Teleport is on its long cooldown.
check: Whether a fight is really starting, where your wave is, how healthy your bot lane looks, and what your Teleport can actually land on down there right now.
breaks: If their top also has Teleport and follows, it is an even fight again. In that case pushing top for plates is the better trade.
basis: pro:Count who can actually arrive before contesting

when: Teleport is in your summoner spells, before 14:00
asks: do I tp back to lane
should I use teleport to get back top
walk or tp to lane
save tp or use it now
say: Teleport to lane if a big wave is about to die under your tower, or walk and keep it if the wave is in the middle.
more: A wave lost under tower is gold and experience you never get back. That is a fair use of Teleport early.
Walking keeps Teleport for grubs or a dragon fight. The price is a few minions if their top shoves while you are on the way.
check: How big the wave heading to your tower is, and how soon the next objective spawns.
breaks: If grubs or a dragon spawn within the next couple of minutes and your team wants to fight, walk and accept the lost minions.

when: their mid is alive, before 14:00
asks: can I roam mid
should I gank mid from top
do I walk mid after shoving
is a mid roam worth it
say: Only roam off a crashed wave: walk mid if their mid is past halfway, or recall on that wave if he's hugging tower.
more: A top laner arriving mid is rarely warded for. The crashed wave gives you the time; a big wave means their top is busy last-hitting it.
A kill or a Flash mid makes the next river fight easier for your jungler. A failed roam costs you a wave or two of experience.
check: Whether your wave is really crashed into their tower, where their mid laner is standing, whether your mid has crowd control to follow, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If their top has already cleared the wave and is pushing back, turn around. The roam is costing you tower plates.

when: game time is between 2:30 and 3:30
asks: do I help with crab
should I go to the scuttle
jungler's fighting at crab do I go
do I leave lane for river fight
say: Shove the wave and step into river if your jungler is contesting the top crab, or stay in lane if your wave is stuck under tower.
more: Both crabs first spawn at 2:55, and the early river fight usually goes to whichever laners can arrive first.
Leaving a wave under your tower to help costs you minions and often the fight too, because you arrive second.
check: Whether your wave is pushed, and whether their top or mid is already walking to the river.
breaks: If their top has the push, tell your jungler to give that crab and take the other one. Do not walk in late.
basis: pro:Take the crab on the side where your lanes can move

when: the enemy top's CS has stopped rising and he is not dead
asks: their top is missing
enemy top left lane what do I do
top went mid do I follow
where did my laner go
say: Ping it and shove the wave into the tower for plates, or follow only if your wave is already crashed and the fight is close.
more: You almost never beat him to the fight he chose. What you can do is make the roam expensive with plates and a lost wave.
If he comes back with a kill but lost a wave and tower health, the lane is still close to even.
check: Whether he recalled, roamed or is waiting in a brush near you. A missing laner is not a confirmed roam.
breaks: If your wave is on your side and you cannot push it quickly, just warn your team and hold. Do not walk up the lane blind.

when: the enemy top has Teleport and you do not
asks: he tp'd bot and I can't follow
their top teleported away what now
I don't have tp and he just left
enemy top used tp bot
say: Take every plate you can while he's gone, or stay at the edge of tower range if their jungler isn't showing on the map.
more: You cannot match the Teleport, so match the gold. Plates and a denied wave can equal what he gained from one kill.
His Teleport is now on cooldown. For the next few minutes you are the top laner with more freedom to move.
check: Whether their jungler also showed bot, and how much health the tower has.
breaks: If their jungler appears top side, drop the tower and back off. The plates are not worth a death while their top is away.
basis: pro:If you cannot contest, take something elsewhere at once

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: when do I ult as Shen
should I Stand United bot
do I ult my jungler
Shen ult now or hold
say: Use Stand United on an ally who will survive long enough for you to land, or hold it if the fight is already lost.
more: Stand United shields the target first and brings you in a moment later, so the best target is one who is still fighting, not one already dying.
Push your wave before you look for it. Every ultimate you cast with the wave on your side costs you minions and tower health.
check: Whether an ally is actually in a fight worth joining, that ally's health, and whether enemies near you can interrupt you before you travel.
breaks: If your own lane opponent can freeze the wave after you leave, weigh the kill against the minions. A saved carry is worth it; an assist on a tank is not.

when: the first tower in your lane has fallen, yours or theirs
asks: tower's down where do I go now
do I stay top after tower
lane's over what now
should I swap lanes after first tower
say: Go to a side lane and let your duo take mid, or cover mid for a wave if nobody's there before an objective.
more: After the first tower, lanes are just waves. Your job is to be where gold is arriving and to hold a side so your carries can stand in mid.
Carries usually take mid for safety. A top laner in the long side lane keeps their farm and pulls an enemy out with them.
check: Which side waves are coming toward your team, who is covering mid, and which objective is next.
breaks: If you are far behind and the side lane is dark, take mid waves with the team and let a stronger ally hold the side.

when: your jungler is level 3 or lower and game time is before 4:00
asks: my jungler's getting invaded do I help
should I leave lane to help jungle
jungler pinged for help in his jungle
do I go help at buff
say: Go if you can arrive before their top does and your wave is not crashing, or stay and tell your jungler to leave the camp.
more: Early jungle fights are decided by which laner gets there first, not by the two junglers.
Arriving second means walking into two players at full health. Then you lose the camp and the lane.
check: Where their top laner is, and where your wave is.
breaks: If their top is already missing from lane, assume he is ahead of you. Ping your jungler out instead of following.
basis: pro:An invade ends when the nearest lane arrives

when: game time is between 7:00 and 8:00
asks: grubs are coming what do I do
how do I set up for grubs
do I need to be at grubs
what's the plan before grubs
say: Shove your wave into their tower just before 8:00 and walk to the pit first, or stay and farm if you cannot get the push.
more: Grubs open at 8:00 and never come back, so it is a single window, and top is the closest lane to it.
Whoever pushes first arrives first. The player still last-hitting under his tower either loses the wave or shows up late.
Grubs pay off later as faster towers, so they matter most if your team plans to push lanes.
check: Whether you can clear the wave faster than their top, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If their top out-pushes you, tell your jungler early. Giving grubs and keeping your wave beats losing both.
basis: pro:The lane that pushes first moves first

when: grubs are available and you are behind your lane opponent in level or CS
asks: I'm losing lane can I go grubs
do I leave lane for grubs if I'm behind
jungler wants grubs but I can't move
should I help grubs or stay top
say: Tell your jungler you cannot move and keep the wave, or go only if the wave is pushed and their top is visible in lane.
more: A losing laner who walks to the pit brings the enemy top with him, stronger and arriving first.
Your jungler can still sneak some of them if their jungler shows elsewhere. That needs your warning, not your body.
check: Whether your wave is under your tower, and whether their top has Teleport.
breaks: If their top just recalled or died, you are free for that window. Go straight to the pit.
basis: pro:Count who can actually arrive before contesting

when: grubs are still alive after 8:00, before 14:00
asks: do I stay for all the grubs
should I go back to lane or finish grubs
their top stayed top while we do grubs
is it worth staying at grubs
say: Help with what dies quickly and go back to your wave, or stay for all of them only if their top is at the pit too.
more: If their top stays in lane he takes plates and a full wave while you watch your jungler hit monsters.
Taking only some of the grubs is a fine result when it means you lose nothing in lane.
check: Whether your team has actually started the grubs, whether their top is in lane hitting your tower, and how big the wave is.
breaks: If your team plans to group and push towers right after, the full set is worth more. Stay and accept the lost plates.
basis: pro:Price grubs against plates and waves

when: grubs are gone and no Herald kill event has happened
asks: what do we do with herald
is herald worth it
should I help herald
where do we use herald
say: Help take Herald when your wave is pushed and use it on the weakest tower, or drop it mid before a dragon to split their team.
more: Herald in a side lane is gold from a tower. Herald in mid just before a dragon forces them to defend in two places.
It shares the top pit, so you are the closest laner. Your push decides whether your jungler can start it safely.
check: Whether your wave is pushed, and when the next dragon spawns.
breaks: If their top and jungler are both top side and yours is not, do not start it. Trade for the dragon instead.
basis: pro:Herald in mid before a dragon buys the river

when: a dragon spawns within a minute, before 14:00
asks: dragon's spawning do I go
should I tp for dragon
my team's at dragon what do I do top
do I stay top during dragon
say: Hold the wave near your tower and give nothing while they fight, or Teleport in only if the fight starts even.
more: When your team plays bot, the only useful thing their jungler can do instead is come to you.
Skipping an even trade and a last plate costs a little. Dying alone top hands back whatever the dragon was worth.
check: Whether your jungler is bot side, whether their jungler is showing bot, and whether your Teleport is up.
breaks: If you see their jungler and top both at the dragon, you are free. Push hard and take plates instead of holding.
basis: pro:The lane without help gives nothing

when: the enemy team has three dragons and the next one spawns within two minutes
asks: they're on soul point what do I do
do I have to group for this dragon
can I keep splitting if they have three drakes
soul dragon coming should I be there
say: Stop splitting and be at the pit before it spawns, or push the far wave first only if Teleport will be ready.
more: Earlier dragons can be traded for towers. The fourth one gives soul, and nothing in a side lane is worth that.
Recall about a minute before so you arrive with items and full health instead of walking in late.
check: Your Teleport cooldown, your unspent gold, and where the far side wave is.
breaks: If your team is too far behind to fight five on five, take Baron or an inhibitor at the same time. Standing nearby gets you neither.
basis: pro:Give early dragons, then fight the one before soul point

when: game time is between 18:30 and 20:00
asks: baron's about to spawn what's my job
how do I set up for baron
what should I do before twenty minutes
where do I go before baron
say: Push the bottom wave now and recall so you reach the top river with items, or hold bottom with Teleport if your team wants a pick.
more: Baron arrives at 20:00 in the top pit. The team with waves pushing and wards down first controls the approach.
A bottom wave crashing as Baron spawns pulls one of them away, or it takes their tower for free.
check: Your gold for a recall, and whether your Teleport will be up by 20:00.
breaks: If your team is behind, do not posture at the pit. Ward it, clear waves and wait for them to start it.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: the enemy jungler is dead and an objective is up
asks: their jungler's dead what do we take
jungler died do we do baron
enemy jungle is down can we do drake
what do we do with their jungler dead
say: Drop your wave and go straight to the objective while his timer runs, or take a tower if the timer is too short.
more: With their jungler dead they have no Smite, so they rarely walk in to contest.
Compare his respawn timer with how long your team needs. If it is close, the tower is the safer payment.
check: Whether the objective is actually up, and whether your own jungler is alive and nearby.
breaks: If your jungler is dead too, do not start a big objective without Smite. Push towers with the numbers instead.
basis: pro:A dead jungler makes the objective free

when: an objective spawns within a minute and you hold enough gold for an item
asks: do I recall before dragon
should I back or keep pushing before objective
I have gold do I base before the fight
one more wave or recall
say: Recall now and walk in with your team, or stay for one more wave only if you have Teleport to arrive on time.
more: Unspent gold does nothing in the fight. Arriving a moment late with an item still beats arriving on time without it, if your team waits.
The real danger is the half-way choice: one more wave, a late recall, and the fight starts while you are in the fountain.
check: Time left until the spawn, and whether your team is recalling with you.
breaks: If your team is already at the pit and about to be forced, skip the recall and go. A fifth body now matters more than the item.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: one team has four elemental dragons and an elder dragon is next
asks: elder's spawning do I split
what do I do for elder
should I tp to elder
do I group for elder dragon
say: Be with your team at the pit before it spawns, or push one side wave first only if you can still arrive early.
more: Elder decides the next fight outright, so there is no tower worth trading for it.
Your job at the pit is the enemy jungler. Stand between him and the dragon, or put your crowd control on him when it gets low.
check: Where the side waves are, and which of you has Teleport ready.
breaks: If your team cannot win the fight at all, sending everyone at the other team's base while they take it is the one real alternative.
basis: pro:If you cannot win the Smite duel, remove their jungler

when: Teleport is in your summoner spells
asks: should I flank with tp
where do I teleport for the fight
tp behind them or to my team
do I tp flank
say: Teleport behind them once they have committed to the fight, or walk in with your team if you have no ward back there.
more: A flank lands on their carries and cuts the retreat, but only after they have used abilities forward.
Too early and they turn on you alone while your team is still out of range.
Place the ward a minute ahead. Looking for one when the fight starts is too late.
check: Whether your team is really gathering to fight, whether there is a ward behind them that they have not cleared, and whether they have started fighting.
breaks: If your team is the one that needs a front line to start, be in front of them. A flank leaves your carries with nobody to stand behind.

when: game time is past 20:00 and Baron is alive
asks: they're doing baron and I'm bot
do I tp to baron or keep pushing
they started baron what do I do
should I end or go back
say: Keep hitting if an inhibitor or better will fall before they finish, or Teleport to the pit if you only have an outer tower.
more: Giving Baron is fine only when you are paid something of similar size. An outer tower or two camps does not match it.
If you do stay, your team must not fight. They clear waves and wait for your result.
check: Whether they have really started Baron, how much health the structure in front of you has, and whether your team can stall without you.
breaks: If you can do neither in time, go home and defend. With Baron buff they will be pushing your base next.
basis: pro:A trade needs something real to take

when: an allied carry has the most kills on your team
asks: do I engage or peel
should I protect our adc
what do I do in fights as tank
do I go in or stay back
say: Stay near your fed carry and stop whoever dives them, or start the fight yourself if you catch one of theirs alone.
more: When the damage on your team sits in one player, the fight is won by keeping that player alive.
Going in first still works on a lone target, because then your carry can hit safely without anyone reaching them.
check: Which enemy is most likely to jump on your carry, and whether your crowd control is ready for him.
breaks: If their team has no divers and just pokes from range, peeling does nothing. Then you have to start the fight or flank.

when: you are the only tank or engage champion on your team
asks: do I have to start the fight
nobody else can engage what do I do
when do I go in
should I engage first
say: Go in when their key defensive spell is used and your team is close, or keep walking at them to threaten it and take space.
more: Your engage is the one thing they must respect. Held, it keeps them off the objective. Thrown badly, it is gone for the whole fight.
Count your teammates in range before you press it. Starting with three while two are clearing a wave loses the fight.
check: How many allies are within range to follow, and which enemy Flashes you have seen used.
breaks: If your team is behind and cannot follow a long engage, use it to peel or disengage instead.
basis: pro:Cooldowns spent before the objective decide it

when: you have more kills or completed items than anyone on your team
asks: I'm the carry how do I fight
I'm fed what do I do in teamfights
do I go first if I'm fed
how do I teamfight when I'm the strongest
say: Let someone else start and come in second onto whoever used their abilities, or flank from the side if nobody can start.
more: When you are the lead, you are also the target. Going first means eating every stun they have.
Entering after their crowd control is spent lets your items actually do damage for the whole fight.
check: Which enemy stuns and roots are still unused before you step in.
breaks: If your team has no front line at all, waiting just loses allies. Pick the closest carry and go while your team is healthy.

when: you are behind your lane opponent by two levels or an item
asks: I'm useless what do I do in fights
I'm behind how do I teamfight
what's my job if I do no damage
how do I help when I'm weak
say: Stand in front of your carry and use your crowd control on whoever dives them, or soak their big abilities and back out.
more: A weak top laner cannot kill anyone, but a stun or a body block still works at any gold level.
Making them spend an ultimate on you is useful, as long as you walk away from it alive.
check: Which enemy threatens your carry most, and how much of their damage you can survive.
breaks: If you would die before doing either, stay at the edge of the fight and join only when their main abilities are down.

when: Teleport is in your summoner spells
asks: when do I tp into the fight
should I teleport now or wait
do I tp before the fight starts
fight's about to start do I tp
say: Teleport just after the fight starts so they cannot turn on you, or walk over early if no fight has begun.
more: A Teleport is slow and visible. Used before the fight, they simply back off or jump the spot where you land.
Used after abilities are down, you arrive as a fresh champion in a fight where everyone else is spent.
check: Whether the fight has truly started, and how healthy your team is when it does.
breaks: If your team is already losing by two players, do not add yourself. Keep the Teleport and take the side tower.

when: your team has another front liner besides you
asks: do I dive the backline
should I go for their adc
front to back or dive
who do I hit in fights
say: Go for their carry from the side when your tank starts, or hit the nearest target if their carry still has Flash and peel.
more: A bruiser on the back line makes their carry stop attacking, even if he does not die.
Hitting the nearest target is slower but safer, and it keeps you near your own carries if their divers come.
check: Whether their carry has Flash or a dash, and who is standing next to him.
breaks: If your own carry is being dived and nobody else can help, turn around. Saving yours is worth more than threatening theirs.

when: an ally is dead with a respawn timer running
asks: we're down one do we fight
should I fight four v five
someone's dead do we still go
do I engage if we're missing one
say: Back off to your tower and clear the wave until they respawn, or fight only on a single enemy caught away from the rest.
more: Four against five is mostly lost before it starts. The cheap answer is to give ground and keep the waves out.
One isolated enemy changes the count back. Kill him fast and you are even again.
check: The ally's respawn timer and how far the enemy group is from the target you want.
breaks: If the missing ally is a support or a weak laner and you are far ahead, the fight can still be fine near your own tower.
basis: pro:Arrive together or do not arrive

when: the enemy team has an assassin with a kill lead
asks: their assassin keeps killing our carry
how do I stop their fed assassin
what do I do about their Zed
should I peel or go in against assassin
say: Stay within reach of your carry and hold your crowd control for the assassin, or engage first while he is not on the map.
more: An assassin needs one clean jump. A stun waiting for him turns his jump into his death.
If you use your crowd control to start a fight, he has a free path. So start only when you know where he is.
check: Where the assassin is before the fight, and whether your stun or slow is ready.
breaks: If your carry has their own escape or a way to go untargetable, you can afford to be the engage instead.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: when do I ult as Malphite
who do I Unstoppable Force
Malphite engage or peel
do I ult their front line
say: Use Unstoppable Force on two or more with their carry included, or hold it to knock up whoever jumps on your carry.
more: Unstoppable Force knocks up everyone you land on, so the value is in how many and which ones.
Ground Slam cuts attack speed. Stand on their attack-based carries after the ultimate rather than chasing a mage.
check: How grouped they are, and whether your team is close enough to follow the knock-up.
breaks: If only their tank is in range, do not spend it. Walk forward and let the threat hold them back.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I fight as Ornn
when do I use Ornn ult
Ornn engage or wait
what do I do in teamfights Ornn
say: Send Call of the Forge God through their team as the fight starts, or keep it to stop a dive on your carries.
more: The elemental slows and makes enemies Brittle. Following with Searing Charge into terrain gives you a knock-up on top.
Because you can forge items anywhere, you can stay with the team before a fight instead of recalling for your gold.
check: Whether there is terrain nearby for Searing Charge, and where their carries are standing.
breaks: If they are spread wide, the ultimate hits one person. Use it on whoever is closest to your carry instead of waiting for a perfect one.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Kennen flank or front
when do I ult as Kennen
how do I teamfight Kennen
do I go in first on Kennen
say: Come from the side with Lightning Rush and use Slicing Maelstrom in the middle of them, or poke with Thundering Shuriken until they group.
more: Kennen stuns anyone he hits three times with abilities, and the storm plus Lightning Rush gets there quickly on a clumped team.
From the front they see you coming and spread out. A side path through an unwarded brush is where the fight is won.
check: Whether the flank brush is warded, and whether their stuns are still available.
breaks: If they have point-and-click crowd control waiting, do not go first. Enter after it is used on someone else.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: when do I fight as Gnar
Gnar teamfight what do I do
should I wait for mega
do I go in as mini Gnar
say: Start the fight when Rage is nearly full and they are near a wall, or kite with Boomerang Throw while Rage is low.
more: Mega Gnar's ultimate throws enemies, and anyone who hits a wall is stunned. The wall matters as much as the transform.
Mini Gnar is a ranged poke champion with only a slow. Fighting then means no stun for your team.
check: Your Rage bar, and whether the enemy is standing near terrain.
breaks: If the fight starts just after you turned back to mini, do not jump in. Stay at range and build Rage again.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: where do I fight as Illaoi
Illaoi teamfight
when do I ult Illaoi
do I go in with Illaoi
say: Fight in the jungle or near walls and use Leap of Faith on several enemies, or stay back if they will not come to you.
more: Tentacles spawn on nearby terrain, and Leap of Faith adds one for each enemy champion hit. A narrow path is your best ground.
In an open lane they just walk away from you, so let the fight come to an objective pit instead of chasing.
check: How many enemies are in range for Leap of Faith, and whether terrain is close.
breaks: If they have ranged champions who can hit you from outside your reach, do not stand in the open. Guard your carry in the jungle instead.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: who do I ult as Camille
Camille teamfight
do I go for the adc on Camille
how do I fight Camille
say: Use The Hextech Ultimatum on their carry when their peel is spent, or lock down whoever dives your own carry.
more: The ultimate anchors one champion in an area. On their carry it removes their damage from the fight for those seconds.
Hookshot needs a wall. Choose your angle before the fight so you can reach the back line and still get out.
check: Whether their carry has allies beside him with crowd control ready, and whether a wall is in range.
breaks: If you are behind and would die inside the zone, use it defensively on the enemy who jumps in.

when: you killed your lane opponent in the last 30 seconds
asks: I killed him what now
just got a kill what do I do
got the solo kill do I recall
killed my laner push or back
say: Push the wave into their tower and take plates if you are healthy, or crash it and recall if your gold buys an item.
more: Either way the wave must reach his tower. A wave left in the middle lets him come back and lose nothing.
Plates are gold now. The recall is power for the next fight. Low health or a missing enemy jungler points to the recall.
check: Your health, where the wave is, and whether their jungler could be on his way.
breaks: If a huge enemy wave is about to hit your tower, clear that first. Losing it can cost more than the kill gave.
basis: pro:Kills are not a lead if the farm went the other way

when: you are two kills or a completed item ahead of the enemy top before 14:00
asks: I'm winning lane how do I use it
I'm ahead top what now
how do I snowball my lead
I'm stomping lane what next
say: Take the tower while plates are up and then move to grubs or Herald, or freeze near your tower if their jungler keeps coming.
more: A lead that stays in top lane helps only you. The tower and the top pit are how it reaches the team.
Freezing denies him everything but ends nothing. It is the right call only when pushing would get you ganked.
check: Where their jungler was last seen, and whether grubs or Herald are up.
breaks: If your team is losing badly elsewhere, the tower matters less than Teleporting to a fight you can turn.

when: your gold is enough for a completed item and your item list has not changed
asks: should I back I have a lot of gold
do I recall or keep pushing
I'm sitting on gold
is it worth backing now
say: Recall after this wave and spend it before the next fight, or stay only if a tower is about to fall.
more: Gold in your pocket is not a lead yet. The enemy fights your old items, not your bank.
A tower in its last hits is the one thing worth finishing first, because it will not wait for you.
check: How soon the next objective spawns, and where the wave will be when you return.
breaks: If recalling now gives up a wave stacked under their tower with nobody to stop you, take the tower hits first.
basis: pro:A lead is not power until it is spent

when: the enemy top's tower has fallen before 14:00
asks: I took first tower now what
tower's down where do I use my lead
got the tower do I stay top
what do I do after taking top tower
say: Move with your jungler into their top-side camps and the top pit, or swap to bot lane so your duo can take mid.
more: With the outer tower gone, the next one sits deep on their side of the map, so pushing on alone is long and risky.
Their top-side jungle is now open. Taking it starves their jungler before grubs or Herald.
check: Which objective is next, and whether your bot lane is willing to swap.
breaks: If your lane opponent is still strong enough to duel you, stay near the wave. A lost side lane gives the tower lead back.

when: you have a kill lead and your team is behind in total kills
asks: I'm fed but my team is losing
how do I carry a losing team
I'm the only one ahead what do I do
team's feeding but I'm strong
say: Group for the next objective so your lead decides the fight, or split one side and make them send two if your team can stall.
more: A single strong player wins a fight only if the others are alive when he arrives. Stay close enough to be on time.
The split works when your team can clear waves safely under tower. It fails when they get dived four against five.
check: Whether your team has wave clear to hold a tower without you, and which objective is next.
breaks: If their carries already out-damage you in a grouped fight, splitting is the only place your lead still counts.

when: you have a kill lead and the enemy jungler has kills or assists on you
asks: their jungler keeps camping me
I'm ahead but getting ganked every time
jungler lives top what do I do
how do I keep my lead when I'm camped
say: Hold the wave near your tower and tell your team to take dragon, or push only when you see their jungler elsewhere.
more: A jungler spending his time top is not on the other side of the map. That time belongs to your bot lane and jungler.
You keep the lead just by not dying. One death to a gank gives him back what the visits cost.
check: Whether river and tri-brush are warded, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If you can kill both of them together, you do not need to hold. Just be sure about that before you try it.
basis: pro:The lane without help gives nothing

when: you are a level ahead of the enemy top and neither of you has a completed item
asks: I'm a level up do I fight
I hit six first should I go in
level advantage what do I do
can I all in I'm up a level
say: Take the fight now while the level gap exists, or shove the wave and deny him experience if your abilities are down.
more: A level early on is raw stats and sometimes a whole ability. It fades as soon as he catches up.
If the fight is not there, pushing him under tower while he is a level down still costs him minions.
check: Whether your key ability is ready, and whether he just bought an item.
breaks: If he has finished an item and you have not, the level alone may not be enough. Trade short instead of committing.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: you are ahead of the enemy top and your jungler is alive, before 14:00
asks: can we dive him
should we tower dive their top
jungler's here do we dive
is the dive on
say: Bring a big wave into the tower and dive once his defensive ability is used, or just take plates if their jungler is unseen.
more: A dive runs on minions holding the tower's attention. Without a wave, the tower does the damage he cannot.
The dive is paid for by what else is open. If a dragon goes at the same time, a kill may still be a loss.
check: Whether your jungler is actually top side, the wave size under his tower, his defensive ability and Flash, and where their jungler is.
breaks: If he clears the minions before you go, back out. Tower shots on two of you turn it into a double kill for him.
basis: pro:A dive runs on minions and one defensive button

when: your team won a fight and two or more enemies are dead
asks: we won the fight what now
we killed three what do we take
after the fight what do I do
they're dead do we push
say: Go to the side wave that is about to crash and push it, or join the team if they are starting Baron or a dragon.
more: Kills pay only when they become a tower or an objective. Somebody has to bring the side wave, and that is usually you.
If everyone chases the last survivor, they respawn into waves pushing your towers and little has changed.
check: Their respawn timers and where the side waves are.
breaks: If you are very low on health, recall straight away. Being back first for the next play is worth more than one wave.
basis: pro:After a won fight, the waves decide whether you got paid

when: your team leads in kills and towers and Baron is alive
asks: we're ahead how do we close
how do we end the game
do we force baron when ahead
we're winning what's the safe play
say: Push the side waves and hold vision around Baron so they must come through you, or take an inhibitor if they stay home.
more: The team in front does not need the risky kill. One greedy chase into their jungle is how leads disappear.
Baron started and then dropped can pull them into a fight on your terms. Finishing it is safest after a kill.
check: Whether their jungler is alive, and whether your side waves are pushing.
breaks: If they have a scaling team that out-fights you soon, do not wait forever. Force Baron after the next pick.
basis: pro:When ahead, let them come to you

when: you have more kills than the enemy top but lower CS
asks: I have kills but less farm am I ahead
am I actually winning lane
I got kills why does he have more cs
is my lead real
say: Treat the lane as even and collect every wave, or look for another kill only when it does not cost you a wave.
more: A kill is a fixed lump of gold, and missed waves add up quietly against it. If the farm went the other way, the items are close.
Compare completed items, not the score. That tells you who wins the next fight.
check: His item list against yours, and where the wave is right now.
breaks: If your kills did become a finished item before his, you are ahead for now. Use it before he completes his.
basis: pro:Kills are not a lead if the farm went the other way

when: you have died two or more times to the enemy top before 14:00
asks: I'm getting destroyed what do I do
I died twice how do I play lane now
lane is lost what now
how do I stop feeding top
say: Let the wave come to your tower and last-hit only what is safe, or ask for a lane swap if he can dive you.
more: Every further death makes him the problem for your whole team. Losing minions is the cheaper price.
Near your tower his jungler has less room, and yours has an easy gank path if he chooses to come.
check: Where the wave sits, and whether he can kill you under the tower.
breaks: If he freezes the wave out of your reach, do not walk up for it. Roam, recall, or ask your jungler to help break it.

when: your CS is well below the enemy top's and you are not dying
asks: he's freezing on me
I can't get any farm
he's zoning me off the wave
how do I get back in lane when I can't cs
say: Ask your jungler to help shove the wave in, or leave lane to take your jungler's spare camp and reset with a recall.
more: A frozen wave only breaks with a second person or a bigger wave. Walking at it alone is how the lane gets worse.
Leaving costs experience, but a recall lets the wave reset itself when the next ones arrive.
check: Whether your jungler is near top side, and whether a camp is free for you.
breaks: If you have Teleport and a big wave is building toward you, recall and Teleport back onto it instead.

when: you are behind and the enemy jungler is alive and near your level
asks: they're going to dive me
how do I survive a dive
top and jungle are diving what do I do
should I leave my tower
say: Kill the minions under your tower so it turns on the divers sooner, or leave the tower and give the wave if two are already there.
more: A dive needs minions to hold the tower's attention. Without them, each second under it costs the divers health.
Keep your one defensive ability until they commit. Used early, it is the signal they were waiting for.
check: How many minions are under the tower, and whether a second enemy is in the brush behind you.
breaks: If you are too low to survive even one rotation, walking away is right. A tower plate is cheaper than a kill and the plate together.
basis: pro:A dive runs on minions and one defensive button

when: you are a tank and behind the enemy top in gold
asks: I'm a tank and behind am I useless
how do I help as a behind tank
I lost lane as tank what now
what do I build when behind on a tank
say: Build against their most fed damage dealer and stay with your team, or catch a side wave only when you see their top elsewhere.
more: Tanks need less gold than carries to do their job. Your engage and your body work the same when behind.
The side lane is where a losing top laner gets killed again. Mid waves with the team are slower but safe.
check: Whether their fed champion deals physical or magic damage, and where their top is.
breaks: If nobody else on your team can catch side waves, take them, but only up to your own side of the river.

when: you are a damage-building top and behind the enemy top by an item
asks: I'm behind on a carry top what do I do
I can't split he beats me
how do I come back on a split pusher
I lost lane on a duelist
say: Farm the side lane he is not in and avoid the duel until your next item, or group if a carry can protect you.
more: A duelist who is behind still out-farms most supports and junglers in a side lane. The plan is waves, not fights.
One completed item often flips who wins the duel, so every death before it delays the comeback.
check: Which lane their top is in, and how far you are from the next item.
breaks: If he follows you to every lane, farm jungle camps your jungler leaves and stay near your team.

when: your outer tower has fallen before 14:00
asks: I lost my tower what do I do now
tower's gone where do I farm
how do I play after losing first tower
do I stay top with no tower
say: Catch the wave near your inner tower and give what is past the river, or swap to a lane where an ally can cover you.
more: With the outer gone, the lane is long and dark. The minions will come to you if you let them.
He now has the choice to roam. Tell your team whenever he leaves, and use that time to farm freely.
check: Whether your jungle on that side is warded, and where their top and jungler are.
breaks: If he takes the wave and then disappears, do not follow into the dark. Push the wave out once and back off.

when: your team is behind in kills and towers and a dragon is spawning
asks: we're losing do we contest dragon
team's behind should we fight for drake
do we give this dragon
we can't fight what do we do
say: Give this dragon and take a tower or their camps on the other side, or contest only if it gives them soul.
more: Fighting an objective one item behind usually loses the dragon and the fight. A trade keeps the gold gap from growing.
Start your trade when they start theirs. Standing near the pit and leaving late gets you nothing.
check: How many dragons they have, and what your team can actually finish on the far side.
breaks: If there is nothing of real size to take, clear waves and keep everyone alive. That is still better than a lost fight.
basis: pro:If you cannot contest, take something elsewhere at once

when: your team is behind and has lost an inhibitor or inner towers
asks: we're getting sieged what do I do
how do we come back late
we're stuck in base
they have baron how do we defend
say: Clear waves from behind your towers and wait for one of them to step too far, or fight when their Baron buff ends.
more: A team ahead gets impatient. The comeback is almost always one enemy caught out of position, then an objective.
Wave clear is your defense. Every wave killed before it reaches the tower is time for your carries' items.
check: Whether anyone on their team is standing alone, and which of your ultimates are ready.
breaks: If they are diving under towers with numbers, do not wait. Fight on the tower while it still stands.
basis: pro:When ahead, let them come to you

when: you are behind and the enemy top has kills or assists on your other laners
asks: he keeps roaming and I'm behind
their top is fed and roaming
do I follow his roams
he left lane again what do I do
say: Stay and take the waves and tower plates he leaves, or follow only if Teleport gets you to the fight on time.
more: Following on foot puts you second into a fight against a stronger champion. The farm he abandons is your way back.
Ping the moment he leaves. A warned teammate who backs off turns his roam into lost minions.
check: Whether he really left or is waiting in a brush, and how much tower he leaves open.
breaks: If his roams keep winning fights for them, your lane gold will not matter. Then group with your team near mid instead.

when: you are behind the enemy top in level or CS, before 14:00
asks: I'm losing lane as Kayle
Kayle is so weak early what do I do
how do I come back on Kayle
do I just farm on Kayle
say: Give up minions you cannot reach safely and keep leveling, or Teleport to a fight only when your team is already winning it.
more: Divine Ascent adds attack speed, range and waves of fire as you level, so experience matters more to you than lane kills.
Later, Divine Judgment makes a teammate invulnerable for a moment. That one button can decide an objective fight.
check: Your level, and whether the wave can be farmed from range.
breaks: If your team is collapsing everywhere, a few safe waves in mid with them is better than staying alone top.

when: you are behind in lane
asks: I'm behind on Nasus
Nasus can't fight what do I do
do I just stack
how do I play Nasus when losing
say: Last-hit with Siphoning Strike near your tower and skip trades, or use Wither to help your jungler if he ganks.
more: Every minion killed with Siphoning Strike makes later ones hit harder, so a quiet lane is a winning lane for you.
Wither slows movement and attack speed. Even when behind, it makes one enemy carry far weaker in a fight.
check: Whether the wave is close enough to your tower to last-hit safely.
breaks: If he freezes you off the wave entirely, leave and take a jungle camp with Siphoning Strike rather than standing and losing experience.

when: you are behind and holding unspent gold
asks: I'm behind on Ornn what do I do
Ornn lost lane now what
should I recall on Ornn
how do I stay useful on Ornn
say: Forge your items in the field and stay with your team for fights, or hold a side wave while upgrading from there.
more: Ornn can buy without recalling, so you lose less time than any other top laner who is behind.
Later you can make masterwork items for allies. That is gold value for your team that does not depend on your lane.
check: Your gold and which resistance their main damage dealer calls for.
breaks: If you are low on health as well as gold, you still need the fountain. Forging does not heal you.

when: the enemy top is ahead and has more completed items than anyone on your team
asks: their top is unkillable
enemy top is fed how do we deal with him
how do I stop their fed top laner
he one v twos us what now
say: Send two to hold him and fight four against four elsewhere, or group and fight him five on five at an objective.
more: A fed side laner wants single answers he can kill. Two players who only clear the wave give him nothing.
The rest of your team must use that time. If they stand still, his split has worked.
check: Whether he has Teleport, and whether your team can win without the two who hold him.
breaks: If he is strong enough to dive two under a tower, do not split up. Stay together and give the outer tower.

asks: split or group
when do I leave the side lane
how long can I stay in side
do I group now
say: Stay in the side lane until about a minute before the next objective, then walk over, or group right away if your team is being forced.
more: Side waves are your gold and their problem, but only until the spawn. A side laner who arrives after the fight starts gave his team a four against five.
Leaving on a pushed wave is the trick. The wave keeps working for you while you walk, and someone on their team has to answer it.
check: When the next objective spawns, how long the walk is from your lane, and whether your wave is pushed before you leave.
breaks: If you have Teleport ready and a safe place to land, you can stay a wave longer. Without it, leave early rather than late.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: Teleport is in your summoner spells and an objective spawns within two minutes
asks: my tower's dying do I tp to save it
tp to defend or save it
they're taking my tower do I teleport
should I tp back to my tower
say: Keep Teleport for the objective if the tower falls anyway, or Teleport to defend only if clearing one wave really saves it.
more: A Teleport spent on a tower that dies regardless is missing at the next fight, and then their side laner is the extra player there.
If one wave clear holds the tower and you can still walk to the objective in time, defending is fine.
check: How much health the tower has, how many of them are hitting it, and how soon the objective spawns.
breaks: If no objective is close and the tower protects your jungle on that side, spend the Teleport. It will be back before it matters.
basis: pro:Teleport decides who has the extra player

when: game time is between 7:00 and 8:00 and you are ahead of the enemy top in level or kills
asks: I'm winning lane do I go grubs
I'm ahead top how do I help with grubs
do I zone their top at grubs
grubs or plates when I'm winning
say: Crash the wave and stand in the river before 8:00 so their top can't join, or stay for plates if their jungler shows bot.
more: When you win the lane, you choose who arrives. Standing between their top and the pit makes the grubs a two against one for your jungler.
If their jungler is on the other side, nobody contests. Then your jungler can take grubs alone and you keep hitting the tower.
check: Whether your wave is crashed, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If their mid can walk up first and yours cannot, your lead in top does not cover that. Tell your jungler to take what is quick and leave.
basis: pro:The lane that pushes first moves first

when: the enemy jungler just killed a dragon or took part in a kill on your bot lane
asks: their jungler's bot what do I do
jungler showed bot can we do something top
he's bot side do we take grubs
enemy jungle is bot what's the play top
say: Call your jungler to grubs or Herald right now if one's up, or push for plates if the top pit is empty.
more: A jungler seen on the far side cannot be top for a while. That is the short window in which nothing you do up here gets punished by him.
The window closes as fast as he can walk back or recall, so start at once or do not start.
check: Whether grubs or Herald are actually up, how long ago he showed, and whether your own jungler is near.
breaks: If their top has the push and your jungler is far away, do not walk into the river alone. Just farm without fear of the gank.
basis: pro:A jungler seen on the far side opens yours

when: you are behind the enemy top in CS or kills and Teleport is in your summoner spells
asks: I'm behind where do I use tp
do I tp bot if I'm losing top
should I tp to the dragon fight when behind
is teleport my way back in
say: Use Teleport on a bot or dragon fight your team is already winning, or keep it for lane if a death would cost a big wave.
more: A losing top laner gets little from his own lane. An assist or two and a dragon elsewhere can be worth more than the minions you give up.
The risk is a fight that is already lost. Joining that one puts you further behind and leaves your tower open as well.
check: How the fight looks before you press it, and where your wave is.
breaks: If their top has Teleport and follows you, he arrives stronger than you. Then stay, and take the wave he walked away from.
basis: pro:Count who can actually arrive before contesting

when: game time is past 20:00, Baron is alive and your team is behind in kills
asks: we're behind and baron's up
how do we stop them taking baron
do we face check baron
they're going to do baron what do we do
say: Keep a ward on Baron and clear the side waves so they can't start it freely, or contest only if their jungler is dead.
more: A team that is ahead starts Baron when your side waves are pushing into you. Cleared waves take that timing away.
Walking into the dark river as the weaker team is how the game ends. A ward tells you whether they started without anyone dying for it.
check: Whether the pit is warded, where their jungler is, and where the side waves are.
breaks: If they start it with their jungler alive and you cannot fight, send someone for a steal only as a last try and have the rest clear waves.

when: your team killed Baron in the last minute
asks: we got baron where do I go
what do I do with baron buff
do I split with baron
baron buff where do I push
say: Recall and buy, then push a side lane with the buff while the others push mid, or stay as five if they can kill you alone.
more: Baron's buff makes the minions near you much harder to clear, so two lanes pushing at once is more than they can answer.
Spend the gold first. A buffed push on old items gives the defenders a real chance to hold until it runs out.
check: Your unspent gold, and which enemies could come to your side lane.
breaks: If their side laner beats you one on one, do not go alone. Push one lane as five and keep the buff alive.
basis: pro:A lead is not power until it is spent

when: you are ahead of the enemy top and the enemy team has a scaling carry
asks: they outscale us how do I use my lead
I'm strong now but they scale
how do we end before they scale
I'm ahead but their team is late game
say: Join every dragon now so they must fight before their items, or take towers with your lead if they give the dragons up.
more: A scaling team wants a quiet map. Dragons put a clock on them, because the fourth one gives soul and they cannot keep giving.
Kills by themselves are a thin lead. Towers and dragons are the part of it that is still there in ten minutes.
check: How many dragons each team has, and how many items their carry has finished.
breaks: If their carry already has more items than you, the window has closed. Stop forcing and play around your own carries.
basis: pro:Early dragons are the clock against a scaling team

when: you are level 6 or higher and ahead of the enemy top
asks: can I dive him as Volibear
Volibear do I ult under tower
when do I use Stormbringer
I'm ahead on Voli how do I kill him under tower
say: Dive him with Stormbringer landing next to the tower so it shuts off, or just take plates if their jungler isn't showing.
more: Stormbringer briefly disables enemy towers near where you land, and gives you bonus health. That is a dive without the tower shots.
Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy you attack. Use it after you land so he cannot walk out while the tower is off.
check: His health and Flash, whether Stormbringer is ready, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If the tower comes back on before he is dead, walk out. Do not stay to finish a kill under a live tower with no wave.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Jax split or group
how do I side lane on Jax
can I duel them on Jax
what's my job as Jax mid game
say: Split and take the duel with Counter Strike ready, or Leap Strike to a minion and leave when a second enemy shows.
more: Counter Strike dodges attacks and then stuns everyone around you, so it wins duels against attack-based champions and does far less against mages.
Relentless Assault builds attack speed the longer you keep hitting, and that speed takes towers quickly once the defender backs off.
check: Whether Counter Strike is ready, and whether the champion answering you fights with attacks or with spells.
breaks: If your team has no front line without you, a split leaves them unable to fight. Then group and jump on their carry after the engage.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Nasus split or group
do I keep stacking or group
should Nasus side lane
what do I do mid game Nasus
say: Keep stacking Siphoning Strike in a side lane and hit towers, or group when an objective fight needs Wither on their carry.
more: Siphoning Strike grows with every unit it kills, so side waves make you stronger in a way a mid-lane standoff never does.
Wither slows one champion's movement and attack speed. In a fight that is close to removing an attack-based carry for its duration.
check: Which enemy answers you, and how soon the next objective spawns.
breaks: If they send a ranged champion who keeps you off the wave, you gain nothing there. Swap sides or join your team.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: who do I ult as Mordekaiser
Morde ult their carry or their tank
when do I use Realm of Death
Mordekaiser teamfight what do I do
say: Use Realm of Death on their strongest carry once the fight starts, or on whoever dives your carry if you can't reach theirs.
more: Realm of Death drags one enemy to a different dimension with you, so their team fights without that player while it lasts.
It also steals a portion of the victim's stats. Pick someone you can beat alone, because nobody can help you in there.
check: Whether you win the one on one against that target right now, and where their carry is standing.
breaks: If you would lose the duel to their carry, do not isolate yourself with him. Take the diver instead or stay and front-line.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Poppy peel or engage
how do I fight as Poppy
who do I ult as Poppy
what's my job in fights Poppy
say: Stay beside your carry and use Steadfast Presence when their diver dashes in, or flank with Heroic Charge if they have no dashes.
more: Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes around you, so a diver who jumps at your carry lands short.
Keeper's Verdict knocks enemies very far away. Sending their front line away at an objective leaves the rest fighting without it.
Heroic Charge stuns only when the target hits a wall, so fight near terrain.
check: Which enemies rely on dashes, and whether a wall is close to the target.
breaks: If their team walks at you without dashing, Steadfast Presence does little. Look for a wall stun on their carry instead.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: who do I ult as Sett
Sett teamfight
do I grab their tank on Sett
when do I use Show Stopper
say: Grab their front liner with The Show Stopper and slam him into their back line, or save it to carry a diver off your carry.
more: The Show Stopper damages and slows every enemy near where the target lands, so the landing spot matters more than who you grab.
Haymaker turns the damage you have taken into a shield and a punch. Take hits first, then cast it.
check: Where their carries are standing compared with their front liner, and how much Grit you have stored.
breaks: If their front line and back line are far apart, the slam hits nobody. Then use it to peel or wait for them to bunch up.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I teamfight as Garen
who do I ult Garen
do I run at the adc on Garen
Garen front line or dive
say: Run at their carry with Decisive Strike for the silence, or stay in front and keep Demacian Justice for whoever drops low.
more: Decisive Strike gives move speed, breaks slows on you and silences the target, which stops a carry casting an escape for a moment.
Demacian Justice is an execute, so it is worth most on a target that is already hurt.
check: Whether you can reach their carry without being held in place, and who on their team is low.
breaks: If they have several stuns or roots between you and the carry, you will not arrive. Fight whoever walks into you instead.

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I teamfight as Darius
Darius who do I hit
when do I ult Darius
do I go for the backline on Darius
say: Fight their front line to build Hemorrhage and finish with Noxian Guillotine, or hold Apprehend for whoever walks at your carry.
more: Hemorrhage stacks with each hit, and at full stacks you gain a large amount of attack damage. The fight goes better the longer you stay in it.
Noxian Guillotine deals true damage that grows with the target's Hemorrhage stacks, so it finishes someone you have already been hitting.
check: How many Hemorrhage stacks your target has, and whether they can simply walk away from you.
breaks: If they are all ranged and keep their distance, do not chase into the open. Stand by your carry and punish whoever comes close.

asks: I'm ranged top what do I do in fights
how do I fight as a poke top
do I front line on a ranged champ
where do I stand in fights as ranged top
say: Poke from behind your front line until someone is low, then go, or back up to your carry if they dive past you.
more: A ranged top laner is a second damage dealer, not a front line. The fight is won before it starts, by health bars at the pit.
Arrive first and let them walk at you. A team that has to start an objective while being poked is stuck in a small space.
check: Whether your team has someone else to stand in front, and which enemy can reach you.
breaks: If you are the only top-side champion and your team has no front line at all, do not fight in the open. Fight at towers or pick off one.
basis: pro:Who starts the objective depends on who wants to be pinned
